science.qualification: Photosphere color from a blackbody at the star's published temperature, dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,625 K and log g 0.93 (u1 0.728, u2 0.067): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The disc is unresolved: no map or absolute brightness is implied. Self-luminous, so no lighting.

science.label: Phase 0.0
science.description: S Vul's light at maximum light (phase 0.0 of its 69.5-day pulsation): 100% of its light at maximum, from the Fourier model Gaia DR3 publishes for the star's G-band time series (vari_cepheid, source 2027971514401523456; 2 harmonics; Ripepi et al. (2023), A&A 674, A17). The star's color (#ffe0c1, its Color dataset) is dimmed to that share of its light. The disc is unresolved, so one value is drawn over all of it, and the darkening toward the edge is the Color dataset's. Over the cycle the model's light falls to 68% of its maximum (0.425 mag peak to peak). No change of color or of size is drawn: the G band stands for all colors here.
science.title: Gaia DR3 · light through one pulsation · phase 0.0
